cs.t: I travel and mostly love out of a suitcase all yeah long, so my best purchases can be put in a bag. Oculus Quest 2 - incredible multipurpose entertainment and excercise device. Turns any hotel room into a gym, movie theater, golf course, table tennis tournament, shooting range and casino. Blon BL-03 super great IEMs for about $25, competes with ones that cost hundreds.
